{{Short description|Indian mathematician (1871–1940)}}
[[File:M. T. Naraniengar.jpg|thumb|M. T. Naraniengar]]
'''Mandyam Tondanur Naraniengar''' (1871–1940)<ref name="gazette">{{cite journal|title=Mandyam Tondanur Naraniengar, 1870–1940|jstor=3606553|journal=The Mathematical Gazette|volume=25|issue=267|date=December 1941|page=265|doi=10.1017/S0025557200060046 |s2cid=250441733 |doi-access=free}}</ref>  was an Indian mathematician. He first proved in 1909 the [[Morley's trisector theorem]] after it was posed in 1899 by [[Frank Morley]].<ref>{{cite web|title=An Essay on Morley's Theorem|url=http://jwilson.coe.uga.edu/EMT668/EMAT6680.F99/Estes/morley/morley.html}}</ref>

He was the president of [[Indian Mathematical Society]] from 1930 to 1932<ref>{{cite web|title=The Succession List of the Office-Bearers of The Indian Mathematical Society|url=http://www.indianmathsociety.org.in/officebearers.htm|publisher=[[Indian Mathematical Society]]}}</ref> and the editor of the ''Journal of the Indian Mathematical Society'' from its founding in 1909 until 1927.<ref name="gazette"/>
